provenance: Main independently authored from the repository FP32 score tree and its own query8 helper; no XeStrata code/helper/proposal or research report body used.
math: Preserve the original root sum tree: each eight-lane head combines its four original lane contributions via(p0+p2)+(p1+p3), then XOR4/2/1; fetch original root lanes for four heads and add sequentially. Eight queries share keys. WG32/SG32, noSLM/XMX/dtypechange.
hypothesis: Fewer subgroup shuffle/reduction rounds may reduce score service cost, offset by larger live key registers and repeated logical key loads across heads. Physical traffic, GRF, spill, occupancy and speed are unmeasured.
